Decorative Candles

Decorative candles enhance the style of a room with their aesthetic beauty. These candles are ideal for consoles, mantelpieces, dining tables, and bookcases. For the dining table, these decorative candles act as a centerpiece. For or the rest of the home, they are useful as an accent décor. Made in different materials, sizes, and designs, decorative candles are suitable for varying indoor spaces contributing to a unique appeal.

 

Pillar Candles

Pillar candles are cylindrical candles with a notable diameter. They are composed of wax that is rigid enough to burn free-standing. Pillar candles are long and wide, so they burn for longer durations.

 

Taper/Dinner Candles

Tapers are long and sleek candles set in the candlesticks set on a dining table. You may wonder that taper candles are even from top to bottom but, most of these candles are thinner from the top than the bottom on a usual basis.

 

Votive Candles

Votive candles are low-height candles that are wider than the taper candles but narrower than the pillar candles. Usually poured into a container, they last up to ten hours once they start burning.

 

Tea Lights

Tea lights are another category of candles that are smaller than votive candles. Tea light candles arrive in self-contained metal or plastic containers. Considerably small in size, tea lights have a short burnout span. These candles last for up to hours usually. These small and lightweight candles are apt for decorations on occasion. Their small size allows for easy floating on the water surface.

 

Scented Candles

Scented candles are made in all shapes and sizes. Votive scented candles are a popular choice of buyers due to their reasonable size and packaging. Most popular scents include floral, citrus, fruity, woody, earthy, sweet, and spicy fragrances, etc.

 

Which Candles are Best?

When the discussion is about the best candles in Pakistan, then it relies on a few aspects. These include the type of wax, the type of candlewick, and the type of fragrance. The best candles are from soy wax, beeswax, or candle wax. These types of wax are not harmful to health. Next up is the wick of fine-quality candles made from cotton. Finally, better quality candles have essential oil fragrances. Essential oil fragrances allow for improved sleep quality, and uplift to the surroundings, and improving moods. These aromas have a positive effect on the mind, body, and atmosphere.

 

How to buy the appropriate candle as a gift?

Many of us wonder about buying a unique gift for our acquaintances, friends, and loved ones. Scented candles are one of those items to gift to close associates for a relishing memory. One can buy an aromatic candle and package it in a wrap, ribbons, or another packing for a simple gift to loved ones.

 

Best Scented Candles in Pakistan

Pakistan has a growing candle manufacturing industry. Most people residing in urban areas urge to bring their favorite scents home with the slow-burning of a candle. You can find the best scented candles in Pakistan from our notable brand. The two factors that determine the best candles in Pakistan include the quality of wax and scent utilized in their manufacturing. Other factors that count in are whether the candle is hand-poured or not and the quality of the candle packaging.

 

Room Decoration with Flowers and Candles

A great way of decorating indoors is by working out an aesthetic and creative combination of flowers and candles. Faux florals in pots and scented candles are a classy décor for empty countertops or consoles in the home. One can pair their favorite candles with a vase of real flowers. One can add complimentary decor next to both these candles and florals as well. Another popular combination of flowers and décor is observed in décor arrangements for intimate moments in people’s lives.

Factors to Consider When Selecting Office Credenzas

Style and Design:

Materials and Finish:

Storage Needs:

Assess your storage requirements. Choose a credenza with the appropriate combination of drawers, shelves, and cabinets, depending on the items you need to store. Ensure it provides sufficient space for your office essentials while maintaining an organized look.

Accessibility and Features:

Utilizing Space Above and Below:

Make the most of vertical space. Consider placing items on the credenza, such as decorative items or frequently accessed files. Additionally, if your credenza has shelves or cabinets below, use them for additional storage to keep the surface clutter-free.

Considering Workflow:

Uplift your Space with Interwood’s Beautiful Dining Room Furniture

A dining room is a place of energy and togetherness that welcomes people to share meals, conversations, experiences and memories. It is an integral part of every home and a key space for family, friends and unexpected guests to enjoy quality time together. Like every room in your home, your dining room should exude an inviting ambiance. This is where the right dining room furniture plays a significant role in defining the aesthetic and feel of the room. Primarily, dining room furniture is made up of a dining table and chairs. However, depending on the proportions of the room, you can also add other dining room decor such as accent tables, table runners, candles, trays, coasters and more.

Interwood’s trademarked dining room furniture is designed with both aesthetic and functionality in mind. Whether you are searching for individual high chairs, a regular dining table, an extendable dining table or complete dining room sets, we offer a wide variety of choices that are sure to meet your needs.   • Promotes Better Eating Habits: when people get more time at the table, they’ll tend to make better choices in their meals as well as spend more time eating. It will also ensure that they eat regularly at the table as opposed to snacking on sofas and other places around the house.
  • Separate the functional areas: proper dining furniture helps to define your dining area and creates a space for all to know where meals should be shared. This again prevents people from using other parts of the home for dining and helps bring people together for meal time.

When it comes to dining room furniture, your personal taste is crucial. Ideally, you should aim for a dining room set that expresses your personal taste while fitting comfortably into the overall style and size of your home. Most importantly, it should provide enough space for guests and create a welcoming feel to your home. Whether you have a large dining room space or a more compact one, Interwood provides premium dining room sets and individual pieces that are designed to suit any size and kind of living space. Important Tips for Buying Dining Room Furniture

Before buying furniture for your dining room, follow these important tips:

  • Quality and durability: dining room tables and chairs see a lot of regular usage, so make sure your new furniture is made of high-quality materials and expert construction to ensure that it lasts for years.
  • Pick Appropriate Chairs: If you're short on space, you need to make the area appear as large as possible. Avoid purchasing high back chairs as these are generally larger and may cause your area to appear smaller.
  • Choose colors wisely: Color is a vital component in the design of a home and your dining table needs to be able to adapt to shifting themes over time. Colors like black, grey, brown, and white are recommended as they match with almost everything and will never go out of style.
  • Go for Comfort: When shopping for new chairs, be sure that they are not only attractive but also pleasant to sit on. Cushioned upholstered dining room chairs will provide greater softer cushioning and back support for more time.
  • Measure your Available Space: Save time by determining the available space in which your new dining table must fit. Measure the length and width of the space and also account for clear space around chairs in order to avoid cramping the area.
  • Consider Your Room’s Shape: Certain table shapes fit better with certain room shapes. The thumb rule is that square and circular tables work well in square rooms while rectangular and oval-shaped tables complement rectangular rooms the best. Keep this in mind when selecting your own dining table.
  • Keep Styles Coordinated: With so many options available, it can be tough to create a unified design. Choosing a matching dining room set is a simple solution to this problem. Sets allow you to obtain everything you need in the same style with ease.
  • Should be Functional: Consider a dining table with some versatility, such as an extendable options that can increase in size. Also consider a table that can be used for writing or general gatherings whenever needed.

Choose the Best Door Designs from a Variety of Finishes and Materials

Create a Beautiful First Impression with our Entrance Door Designs

A main door is the first impression of your home or office and sets the mood for your entire space. Interwood offers a wide variety of entrance door designs, each with its own character, material and style. From imposing designs, to those that are sleeker and inviting, all our doors are specially crafted and made from durable materials and available in color options to suit your style.

There are many things you should consider when purchasing an entrance door design in Pakistan. Security is a major factor to consider as doors should be robust enough and fitted with reliable lock systems to keep out unauthorized visitors. Secondly, an entrance door should complement the existing home or office design. Thirdly, if it is directly exposed to the elements, it should be made of materials that resist weather changes such as extreme heat and cold. All our doors are made with durable materials such as MDF, solid-core wood, melamine and different finishes for a beautiful look. Lastly, it should suit your budget and offer long-lasting value.

The Most Reliable Wooden Door Designs in Pakistan

Wooden doors are generally preferred due to their durability, energy efficiency, and ability to resist harsh weather conditions. All of Interwood’s doors are manufactured with different wood grain textures of solid core, hollow core, and solid wood like Oak, Ash, Teak, Walnut, Mahogany, Beech and Yellow Southern Pine Wood, which are either polished or painted in a variety of finishes.

From beautiful exterior doors to inviting interior doors, we have complete range to suit any space and need. We offer supreme quality and craftsmanship at unmatched prices, which is why we are today Pakistan’s most trusted furniture solution. We use a variety of woods in our wood door designs like:

Ash Wood:

Ash Wood is a light-colored, smooth-grained hardwood found on the East Coast and other parts of Canada. and in parts of Canada. This wood is popular choice for exquisite furniture because of its straight grain and beige-to-light-brown color. Interwood uses this imported wood in its multiple mid-century modern door designs like York, Scot, Free, Mod, Tria, Linia, Louver and more as it is one of the most durable, lightweight and attractive woods and absorbs wood dyes effectively.

Beech Wood:

Beech Wood is an extremely robust, hefty and straight-grained wood native to Europe, Asia and North America. It is known for its mild tones and exceptional resistance to all types of finishes. Normally it is thought to be a white wood but it can range from light to dark brown as well.

Aside from its toughness and versatility, one of the key advantages of this wood is its exceptional value and overall affordability. Due to its toughness and ability to resist scratches, Interwood regularly uses this wood in a variety of furniture items including doors, home & office furniture and more to give unmatched value and quality.

Mahogany Wood:

Mahogany is a world-class wood species that comes in different variants based on its origin, including African, Cuban, Honduran, Santos and Philippine mahogany. It is a heartwood with occasional dark crimson streaks in deep red-brown hues. Because of its durability and superior stability, African mahogany is one of the most preferred species that Interwood uses in a variety of its furniture including many door designs. This wood is appreciated for its durability and ability to be carved with fine detailing. It has a deep rich color, an appealing grain, ability to be stained, and glues firmly to objects.

Teak Wood:

Teak wood is becoming increasingly popular and can now be found in many countries throughout the world, cementing its position as the most durable wood available. Its intrinsic qualities make it resistant to moisture and temperature fluctuations, allowing it to be changed into almost any function. Teak wood is known for wooden furniture projects in North-America and Asia and Interwood uses it in most of its furniture including doors, tables, chairs and more. Because of its high oil content, strong tensile strength, and tight grain, it is an excellent choice for outdoor furniture and can survive harsh conditions for many years with little upkeep.

Walnut Wood:

Walnut wood is the most valuable amongst woods and is well-known for its characteristic dark color with attractive grain patterns. It polishes to a very smooth finish and ranges in color from milky white in sapwood to dark chocolate in heartwood. Interwood uses walnut wood in solid wood furniture such as interior and exterior doors as well as a variety of home furniture.

Southern Yellow Pine Wood:

One of the most important sources of soft wood products in the United States is southern yellow pine wood. It is not only robust, rigid, and dense but it also holds nails and other fasteners exceptionally well, making it an excellent choice in residential and commercial construction. Southern yellow pine wood has a distinct cellular structure making it a popular choice for pressure treatment. Furthermore, its unusual grain pattern and enticing golden tone make it an excellent choice for anyone seeking to highlight its natural beauty. We use this appealing wood in a variety of furniture products and door designs including sliding doors.

Important Tips for Choosing Door Designs

Here are some important tips when choosing and installing a new door:

  • Select the most Appropriate Materials: Many homeowners overlook the weather conditions in their area when selecting a new door. Ideal doors must be made of durable materials to resist harsh weather conditions, providing insulation and protection against draughts.
  • Safety & Security: Most door materials perform equally well in terms of strength, so it is important to choose a door with a robust security system.
  • Accessibility: Always consider the size of large furniture etc. before installing a door. Select a door that is wide enough for your existing furniture to prevent issues in the future.
  • Matching Aesthetics: Before choosing the color of your door, do consider aesthetics as well as the design of your own home to prevent clashing.
  • Cost-Effective: Above-all, choose a door design that provides the best value while having all the important features and that best suits your budget.

Added Benefits of Installing Doors

Modern door designs come with multiple benefits such as:

  • Increased Security: durable and sturdy structures with security mechanisms provide an added layer of protection against unauthorized visitors
  • Energy Efficiency: advanced materials with superior insulation stop cool air from escaping in the summer and cold air from entering in the winter, naturally maintaining a comfortable temperature and reducing costs
  • Noise Control: reduces unwanted noises from entering your home while providing an additional element of privacy
  • High Return on Investment: new doors provide an outstanding return on investment once they are installed because of their robust construction and ability to resist wear and tear.

Why Interwood is the Best Choice for Modern Door Designs?

With nearly half-a-century of experience, Interwood uses unmatched innovation and technology to create the highest-quality door designs in Pakistan which are today widely known for their beauty, functionality and durability. All of our designs including kitchen door design are also treated to resist heat, scratches and fading, making them the ideal long-term solution for homes, offices, businesses, institutions and more. Ergonomic Chair in Pakistan

Sitting in the wrong posture or discomforting chairs for longer hours leads to a lot of neck and back-related problems.  Sitting in an uncomfortable chair for prolonged study or office work accomplishment leads to unproductivity and restlessness. Nowadays, ergonomic study chairs are found widespread in many furniture outlets and online stores. Ergonomics refers to the aspects of chairs that allow for psychological and physiological principles for a comfortable seating experience. In this age health issues are a common problem and neck or back strain make as one of the prominent aspects.

 

Ergonomic Chair Price

Choosing the best chair for focused study hours is an essential step. Whether using books as a medium or a laptop as a medium it is important to have a reasonably planned space to sit in. A good seating environment leads to utter mental satisfaction and results in dedicated study hours, As the number of features increases in an ergonomic chair, its price tends to increase as well. Low-quality chair build will not last long and expire soon due to the cheap quality material. On the other hand, ergonomic chairs with top-quality materials and high-end features cost a considerable fortune.

 

Buy Ergonomic Chairs Online

The sedentary lifestyle of the current age has increased the risk of health problems and early death rates. People of older ages had a healthier lifestyle which led to an extended life. They were more active and hardworking with a lot of traveling by foot. The unhealthy lifestyle and junk food have impacted our lives in a harmful manner. Where an extensive range of health diseases exist in this age ergonomic chairs are designed for many adjustability features to allow for a relaxed and comfortable time during work.

 

High-Quality Ergonomic Chairs at Interwood

Deciding for a home study or office setup requires some basic elements. The first thing to look for and buy is a well-crafted study table. Next up a study chair is required to pair with the table. The study chair can be bought from the same online store or any other, it all depends on one’s choice.

 

Look for these Aspects in an Ergonomic Chair

Studying or sitting in front of the computer for long hours causes restlessness when there is no proper seating arrangement. To avoid such problems an ergonomic chair is the ultimate solution to avoid any neck and back pain problems. When buying an ergonomic chair look for the following aspects in it:

  • Lumbar Support

Lumbar support is an aspect included in ergonomic chairs that prevents any health-related problems in the lower back. An ergonomic chair allows for lumbar adjustment for a proper fit and support to the inward curve of the lower spine.

  • Backrest

The backrest of an ergonomic chair should be considerable in size ranging somewhere between 12 to 19 inches wide. The backrest should be adjustable in forward and back angles with a locking mechanism to secure it from going too far. The inclusion of the adjustment feature of height and depth of the chair will be an additional feature of functionality in separable backrests.

  • Seat Material

The ergonomic study chair should have a comfortable fabric or cover on top and reasonable padding inside to sit comfortably for an extended period. Try buying a chair that has a breathable fabric covering on top rather than a harder one.

  • Armrests

Armrests are a must factor for comfort and support in an ergonomic chair. An additional factor of appreciation is the inclusion of the adjustability feature.

  • Swivel

The factor is rotation is common in most ergonomically shaped chairs. Rotatable chairs allow for easy access to office supplies, files, or any other errands.

Ergonomic Features Catering to Individual Preferences:

Adequate cushioning is essential to ensure comfort and proper blood circulation while sitting throughout the day. Chairs with thick, high-density foam provide excellent support and prevent the development of pressure points. Moreover, the upholstery should be breathable to prevent the buildup of heat and moisture, especially during long working hours. This helps maintain a comfortable seating experience.

Maximizing the Lifespan of Your Executive Chair: Important Maintenance Tips

Maintaining and extending the lifespan of your executive chair is crucial for ensuring a comfortable and functional workspace. Here are some tips to help you achieve this:

  1. Regular Cleaning: Dust and debris can accumulate on your chair, leading to wear and tear. Regularly vacuum or wipe down your chair with a soft damp cloth to prevent the buildup of dirt.
  2. Proper Adjustment: Adjust the chair to fit your body properly. This not only enhances comfort but also prevents undue stress on the chair's components.
  3. Avoid Overloading: Ensure that the chair is not regularly subjected to weights exceeding its recommended capacity. Overloading can significantly reduce the lifespan of the chair.
  4. Check and Tighten Screws: Periodically check and tighten any loose screws or components to prevent the chair from becoming wobbly or unstable.
  5. Lubrication: If your chair has any movable parts, apply appropriate lubricants to ensure smooth movement and prevent unnecessary friction and wear.
  6. Use Appropriately: Encourage proper usage of the chair, such as avoiding leaning too far back or putting excessive pressure on the armrests, to prevent undue strain on the chair's structure.
  7. Avoid Moisture and Sunlight: Protect the chair from direct sunlight and moisture, as these can cause fading, discoloration, and damage to the materials.
  8. Proper Storage: If you need to store the chair for an extended period, ensure it is in a clean, dry environment to prevent any damage from dust, pests, or other environmental factors. Wrap it in plastic to help extend its life during storage.

By following these tips, you can significantly extend the lifespan of your executive chair, maintaining both its functionality and aesthetic appeal for years to come.

Aside from adding beauty and style to your home or office, glass doors have several functional advantages over conventional doors:

  • They Offer an Uninterrupted View: a beautiful view adds elegance to a space while increasing its value. Glass doors are perfect for preserving a view while giving a more open look to any space.
  • They allow natural light in: Glass doors allow natural light to pass through, keeping rooms brighter and well-lit for longer in the day, eliminating the need for artificial lighting.
  • They make rooms seem more spacious: Unlike conventional doors, glass doors allow you to see through to the other side, giving a less-constricted and more open view, hence creating the illusion of more space.
  • They’re easy to clean and maintain: Glass doors can be wiped clean with a simple liquid cleaner and cloth and tend to catch less dust than traditional doors, making them extremely easy to maintain over time.
  • They are termite-proof & rust-free: Unlike wooden doors with metal components, glass doors do not warp, rust or attract termites. When exposed to humidity over time, wood and other metal doors may warp, sag or corrode, whereas a glass doors are immune to such factors.
  • They have commercial applications: Glass doors are becoming increasingly popular in workplaces and companies since they not only create a professional and inviting feel but can also be branded with stickers without disrupting the entrance view.
  • They bring a modern touch to any space: Glass doors are popular because they provide a light, modern and sleek appearance to any space, immediately uplifting the look of an entire room or wall.

Hinged Glass Doors:

Hinged doors have been popular for many years and are still used in even the most modern settings. They can be used externally or internally and can swing inwards, outwards or both directions depending on your preference making them ideal for a variety of uses.

Bi-folding Doors:

Bi-folding glass doors are constructed from bi-folding glass panels with multiple wood and glass door designs, available in framed or unframed configurations. They are often made up of two or more panels that may be folded or run down a sill track to provide the illusion of a larger interior to the house or office.

Glass Sliding Doors:

The most common choice among home and office designers is a sliding glass door style. These are big glass door constructions that typically take up the bulk of the wall space and are always installed as two panels of glass (one fixed and one moveable). The door is mounted on a sliding panel that runs parallel to the walls in a sliding glass door configuration. If you do not want to compromise on the view while opening up closed spaces, a sliding glass door design is the most suitable solution.

Tips on Choosing the Right Glass Door

Priority should be given to safety features: No one wants a product that is harmful to their children, so when purchasing bed for your child, safety should be your top priority. Height should be given priority: It is also important to select the proper height of the bed to ensure maximum comfort and adequate relaxation. Look for the beds with the proper height so that kids can climb in and out safely without supervision.

 

Choose a bed that resists scratches: if you want your kid’s bed to look presentable for years, look for the one that resists unnecessary damages like scuffs, marks, chips, and scratches, etc. during their playtime.

Buy Recliners Online in Pakistan

Recliners are the type of sofas that recline to provide maximum comfort to the body of a sitting person. Common features found in recliners include backrest, massage options, and footrests amongst many others. If you are looking for premium quality recliners online in Pakistan then you are on the right online store. We offer free home delivery in selected cities and a one-year official warranty as well. Recliner Sofa Price in Pakistan

Recliner sofas are becoming a popular furniture item in Pakistan day by day. More and more people tend to buy these sofas to relax their bodies and get relief from stress. No need to waste time by physically visiting stores. Shop the best recliners for reasonable prices from online stores and get them delivered to your doorsteps. Recliner prices in Pakistan vary according to their construction, quality and, power features.

Reasons to Buy Recliners

Comfortable

Comfort is the major priority in sofas or chairs. It is useless to spend all the money on a chair that lags behind the basic features of comfort and relaxation. Paying good sums of money is only good to get one of the best chairs with maximum comfort. Recliners are designed for the best level of comfort and they incorporate many features for an extended relaxing time. They provide maximum comfort when one watches a TV program or movie on the LED.

Fights Stress

Recliners are specifically designed to resolve the stress and body pain problems of the seated person. The available reclining options and the leg support provide extended comfort to the back and body in general. These recliner chairs have proven benefits to both mental and physical health. An accurate amount of leisure time is highly essential to combat fatigue, headache, and body aches.

Counts in as Modern Furniture

Recliners are categorized as modern furniture owing to the number of features they incorporate. They have motors and other mechanisms to provide the best sitting experience. Recliners are constructed with both fabric and leather upholstery. Those who wish to fancy up their living spaces with color and vibrant furniture articles can explore their options in chic and beautiful fabric patterns. Leatherette recliners have a bold visual appearance and they are an ideal option from the aspect of durability. Leatherette recliners are easier to clean and maintain which makes them a popular customer choice.

Improves Blood Circulation in Lower Body

These days numbness in the feet and legs is common with young and elderly due to certain postures or extensive periods of sitting and standing. Recliner chairs are designed for increased blood circulation with the available features of adjustment in various positions. Lifting the footrest provides considerable relief to the legs and feet.

Relives Pain and Pressure

Looking for a way to soothe aching limbs? Recliners are an ideal option to buy in this case because they provide excellent lumbar support. Most adults have the problem of lower back pain and most of the time this occurs due to job-related stress. Any kinds of shoulder, neck and back pain problems are treated to a greater extent by recliner chairs.

Extended Usability

Though recliner chairs are expected to be more expensive than normal chairs they last up to ten years or more thanks to their build quality. Durability is an obvious factor in recliners and the motors used in these sofas come with an obvious warranty period and last many more years.

FAQ’s

1. What is the difference between the operating mechanism of manual and power recliners?

Manual recliners incorporate the feature of manual adjustability rather than motors. The occupant has to push on the armrests and lean backward for adjusting the position of the recliner. The footrest is adjusted by utilizing the body weight. Some recliners may have the option of the lever while may not.

Power recliners have an automatic mechanism to deal with seat adjustment. Electric motors extend and position the recliner with the push of a button. Physical effort is not required and this aspect makes recliners ideal for elderly and sick people.

2. What problems can I face with a power recliner over years?

Problems in power recliners are negligible as compared to manual recliners. Indeed, they have more settings and positions as compared to the manual recliners. Power recliners face fewer breakages due to automatic operation. They wear less over time and have a longer lifespan than manual recliners.

3. How long will my newly bought recliner last?

Well, there is no definite answer to this question. The lifespan of recliners depends on the way they are handled. Typically, a recliner bought from a branded outlet would have a warranty of at least 1-year. The lifespan of the recliner ultimately depends on the way they are handled. Using the recliners with care makes them last for up to ten years and more while rough handling may turn them dysfunctional in a very short duration.

4. How long do the recliner motors last?

The motors used in power recliners are made to last for uncountable years. They are designed according to modern principles for a top-notch experience of reliability. Typically, if used with care, the recliners can last up to ten years.

Swivel Rocking Chairs

Swivel rocking chairs are nothing different from the common types of rocking chairs. They consist of a rotatable base. This is an additional feature, and these chairs are popular with the younger people. This feature is mostly added to the spring or gliding rocking chairs.

 

Spring Rocking Chairs

The springs are protected to avoid damage and prevent things from getting stuck in the springs. Spring rocking chairs are not inexpensive and cost a sum on the pocket.

 

Reclining Rocking Chairs

These are great because they have an added feature to help you relax - you can adjust them to change your position. For example, you can choose to adapt them to a flat place for a resting position or keep them upright.

Elegant, Durable, and Versatile Kids' Single Beds

Your child's bedroom is more than a place for sleeping; it is their space to dream, play and create as they grow up. That’s why it is essential that their room furniture helps utilize their space effectively and gives them the room they need to work and play. Choosing the right kids single bed is a great way to ensure that the room space is used well and that they have a comfortable place for all their activities day and night.

When choosing the right bed (or beds) for your children, it is important to understand their needs to ensure that it fits into their work and playtime routines. A single bed is more space effective and allows them to keep the rest of the room free for activities, making it easier for play time. Interwood offers a wide range of vibrant single beds for girls and boys in a variety of materials and finishes that are designed to create a cozy and fun environment in any room.

Our single beds are also versatile, ensuring that they can be used as your child grows older. Despite being a single bed, many of our designs also have enough space to accommodate two people for story time. Choosing a single kids bed from Interwood ensures that you get maximum long-term value for your kid’s room.

 

Important Factors to Consider Before Buying Kids Single Beds

If you’re looking to buy kids single beds, consider the following important factors:

Choose a Timeless Bed:

It's easy to get caught up in the moment when you envision your child's room filled with colorful furniture. But keep in mind that kid’s bed is a long-term investment, so choose one that will last for years to come.

Choose an Age-Appropriate Bed:

Avoid purchasing overly large beds (like a queen-sized bed) as a solution to make your kids furniture last longer. Look for a bed size that suits his or her current need as well as for the next few years. Then consider upgrading later at the appropriate time.

Consider Quality and Durability:

Durability is undoubtedly one of the most important things to consider when purchasing a bed. Ensure that it is made from high-quality materials and that it will resist the stresses of play time. Also, make sure the bed is strong enough to support your child's weight as he or she grows up.

Consider Safety: 

No one wants a product that is harmful to their children, so when purchasing bed for your child, safety should be your top priority. Ensure that bed frames do not have any sharp or pointed edges. Also keep in mind that children will inevitable jump on beds and crawl underneath them during playtime, so ensure that there are no hidden elements that can cause injury. Also ensure that they do not include harmful chemicals and paints that can cause allergies.

Consider Height:

It is also important to select the proper height of the bed to ensure maximum comfort and adequate relaxation. Look for the beds with the proper height so that kids can climb in and out safely without supervision.

Scratch-Resistant Bed:

If you want your kid’s bed to look presentable for years, look for the one that resists unnecessary damages like scuffs, marks, chips, and scratches, etc. during their playtime.

Select the Best Mattress:

The right mattress is just as important as the right bed (if your child sleeps well, so will you), so don't skimp. Look for a mattress that has a flat surface, a comfortable firmness, is environmentally friendly, and is reasonably elastic. Do consider your child's age and weight, as well as the mattress size, filling, durability, etc.

Consider your child's Viewpoint:

Above all, your kids’ opinion is as important as the design of the bed itself. Remember, you are not simply purchasing furniture for your kid's room; you are creating a world in which they will spend a significant amount of their time – alone and with friends and family. Children have their own ideas about how the world should be and it is always advisable to bring them along for shopping before making a selection. As a result, your child will more likely to get attached to the room and enjoy spending time there.

The Wilson single bed is designed to blend in with any room's décor with a charcoal grey and beige finish headboard that complements its stylish metal legs. This bed, made of high-quality materials, provides comfort as well as long-lasting durability, with the added benefit of compactness to easily fit in small spaces. With the changing dimension of the room, you may place the bed as per your choice and preferences.

Are you looking for a single bed with a simple shape and pattern to accompany your child's adolescent development? With the Woodson single bed, you can add some fun to your children's bedrooms. This bed is distinguished by its distinct trendy headboard design in solid Pine wood, and it is also coated with a beautiful brown polish to give it a glossy finesse, as well as the added benefit of being easy to maintain, making it a favorite for both kids and parents.

Sydney Bed:

Our Sydney single bed is crafted with light oak MFC and upholstered headboard in dark grey fabric makes this bed truly unique. Its shape is truly unique, making this model not only extremely comfortable but also ideal for free and creative play. Suitable for a variety of age groups, including both children and adolescents, as well as both boys and girls.

 

Choose Interwood for the Most Affordable Single Beds for Kids

The Advantages of Sliding Doors in any Space

  • Energy-Efficient: sliding doors can be left partially or fully open or closed to help keep spaces cool in the summer and warm in the winter, saving money on additional heating and cooling.

Important Aspects to Consider when Buying Sliding Doors

Choose Durability:

Factors to Consider When Choosing Visitor Chairs

collections.title: Wall Mirrors
collections.description:
Style up your Space with Our Range of Elegant Wall Mirror Designs

An ordinary wall is like a blank canvas there are many ways to decorate and transform it into a work of wonder. Wall mirrors are a great way to spruce up plain walls while adding depth and functionality. Wall mirror designs are easy to install and also ideal of a variety of spaces such as bedrooms, lounges, hallways, bathrooms and more.

We offer a range of elegant wall mirror designs in a variety of sizes and frame designs to suit your space’s style and size. Rest assured that you can find the perfect mirror for your home at Interwood.

Important Factors to Consider Before Choosing Wall Mirrors

Choosing the right wall mirror can do more than just improve the look of a wall or room. It can create the illusion of making a room look larger, distribute light through a space and act as a focal point. Here are some tips on selecting the right wall mirror for your space:

Choose Quality Material:

if you are selecting a mirror with a frame, ensure that the frame design complements the wall/space where it is being placed and also ensure it is made with high-quality materials for durability.

Choose the Right Size:

The right mirror size is critical for creating the desired effect. Mirrors can be used as a focal point, a decorative accent or simply as a background in a room. Mirrors of various shapes and sizes are used for each effect. Before selecting the mirrors, keep your wall size and room size in mind.

Choose the Best Style:

Another important aspect is selecting the right mirror style. Mirrors have the ability to reflect your interior design in the most fascinating way. If you have a minimalistic interior, a mirror with frame will add a whimsical touch. If you want to add a retro touch, choose an antique mirror with a more decorative frame.

Consider the Design Objectives:

If you are considering purchasing a mirror, you should have some end design goals in mind. For example, you might want a mirror for the wall of your dining room, a full-bodied mirror for your vanity sessions, or mirror accents in your sitting area. Make sure that you are clear about how the mirror will be used once kept in the space. Consider what you want to convey with your mirror choices. This will assist you in selecting the appropriate mirror.

Choose the Right Shape:

The shape of the mirror is an important factor in enhancing interior aesthetics. Choosing between a rectangular, round, square or oval mirror can help add a unique design element to your wall or space.

Keep Budget in Mind:

Above all, before purchasing a wall mirror, always consider your budget. Always invest in quality mirrors that are long-lasting and deliver great value for money.

Benefits of Placing Wall Mirrors

A Useful Accessory:

Wall mirrors are great for checking your own reflection, making them extremely useful when getting ready and selecting outfits or just generally checking out your own look throughout the day.

Create the Illusion of Space:

Mirrors are often used by interior designers as a way to create the illusion of space and depth in more compact rooms. Mirrors reflect the environment that they’re placed in, helping to make rooms look larger, more expansive and open, making them a great tool to add space to smaller rooms.

Help Brighten Spaces:

In addition to making spaces look larger, mirrors are also effective in carrying light and illuminating dimly lit spaces. Placing a mirror near or opposite a window can help carry more natural light into a space without the need for additional lighting.

Add an Excellent Design Element:

In addition to being functional, mirrors themselves are a beautiful decorative element and can be used to add design and detail to bland walls and rooms.

Can Conceal Imperfections:

Mirrors are ideal in masking imperfections in walls such as minor cracks, scraped paint, nail holes and more while adding to the overall appeal of a wall.

They Create a Statement:

A mirror is a great way to create a statement in any room and can become the focal point of an entire space. Instead of placing mirrors in the corners of walls, place them in the center to create a beautiful impression. An oversized mirror, for example, creates a grand and modern look for large rooms.

Mirrors improve the aesthetics of a room:

Mirrors can make a room look more beautiful and welcoming. Use a mirror's reflection to draw attention to other beautiful details in and around your room such as lights, decorations and furniture items.

Mirror Types for Every Room

Because wall mirrors take up limited space, they are ideal for placing in even the smallest areas of your home and can be used just about anywhere.

Hallways:

Placing a mirror in a hallway (particularly near your entrance) is a great way to create grandness upon entry while giving you a place to do last-minute appearance checks before heading out.

Bedrooms:

Placing a mirror in the bedroom at the foot of the bed is a great way to bring in light and make your room appear larger and brighter. They’re also ideal for helping get dressed in the morning or evening.

Living Rooms:

Living room mirrors are mostly decorative and designed to add visual interest to the room. Wall mirrors work well because they free up floor space for functional furnishings. Large, rectangular mirrors above fireplaces and mantles, for example, make a bold statement, whereas smaller mirrors can be used as part of a gallery wall.

Bathrooms:

Mirrors are essential in the bathroom and are necessary for beauty routines as well as getting ready. Hence, pick the one that suits your bathroom’s size and space.

Multiple Wall Mirror Designs in Pakistan

Interwood is a one-stop shop for customers when it comes to contemporary mirror designs in multiple styles and shapes. All of our mirrors are designed keeping in mind the overall appearance and feel of your room. The following design options are available at Interwood:

Rectangular Mirrors:

Most people are familiar with the standard rectangular-shaped mirror; after all, it is simple, versatile, and timeless. If you’re facing difficulty in finding the right design option, a rectangular mirror is a perfect choice for those looking for full-length mirror. You can also change its orientation from vertical to horizontal, based on your preferences. Horizontal mirrors draw attention to the width of the room while long vertical mirrors draw attention to the height.

Square Mirrors:

If you're looking for a decorative piece, square mirrors are ideal for making an elegant statement. Their compact and symmetrical style are perfect for even smaller walls, making them idea for bedrooms, hallways and bathrooms.

Oval Mirrors:

Oval mirrors give a more traditional look to a wall and also help to break the straightness of a room’s design. Add an oval mirror to a hallway or bedroom for a classic and beautiful look.

Round Mirrors:

A round mirror is primarily used to soften the sharp edges of the objects around it and provide a subtle appearance. They help to create more space and serve as a great focal point in most rooms.

Interwood Offers Wall Mirror Designs in Multiple Finishes and Styles

With multiple design options, Interwood offers wall mirrors that come in different sizes, materials, finishes and styles that best suit your tastes and needs. Our framed wall mirrors (that most mirrors fit into) give a finishing touch that enhances the overall appearance of any interior. Made of different frame materials like MFC, metal, or polyresin, etc. these mirrors easily blend in with any interior.

To achieve a Scandinavian aesthetic, choose a light wood both in terms of color and weight. Solid oak, especially when stained darkly, works best in more traditional settings. Metal framed mirrors, with their eye-catching finish, will add an industrial design appeal making them a good option as decorative pieces.

Elegantly Designed Wall Mirrors at Affordable Prices Only at Interwood

When it comes to purchasing wall mirrors, Interwood is the best place to be. We make sure that all of our products provide the best value at the lowest possible price. So, if you need high-quality wall mirrors, Interwood is the place that offers the most affordable wall mirror prices in Pakistan with a range of beautiful designs.

Browse our collection of beautifully-framed wall mirror online Pakistan at Interwood.pk or visit any of our nationwide showrooms to buy cost-effective mirrors and have them delivered to all major cities in Pakistan. You will receive your stylish wall mirrors safely at your doorstep within the time frame specified.
